queries.query: Fengshun China official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Natural Resources Bureau
queries.result: Discovery identified the official Fengshun County government portal and its Natural Resources Bureau. Official registration announcements were found, but no public Fengshun parcel viewer or anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.result: 官方检索结果确认丰顺县自然资源局负责统一确权登记、权籍调查、不动产测绘及成果应用，并发现不动产登记公告及附图；未发现可匿名访问、返回安全宗地标识与完整几何的公开地图或接口。

registryEvidence.localCustodian: The official Fengshun County government portal identifies the Fengshun County Natural Resources Bureau (丰顺县自然资源局) and states that it organizes and guides unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral/right-enquiry work, real-estate surveying, and results use.
